output_deficiencies.finding: SemanticModel/ParcelWarehouse and source-backed SemanticModel/Parcel returned explicit-connection credential errors. The earlier Terminal captures succeeded when that connection was available.
output_deficiencies.treatment: Keep the genuine Notebook error output. No connection, credential, gateway, tenant or identity setting was created or changed. Re-capture the two successful mappings only after the authorised matching connection exists.

verification_limits: All 78 authored Terminal output panels now have a capture-bound Notebook output. The other 42 static Notebook outputs are safe inspection/check/first-task observations; 263 cells have source/type assessment without invented execution output.

Catalogue-free Health and Test without the source project are invalid probe requests, not evidence of a CLI/Notebook mismatch.
No live Azure capacity resume/suspend was authorised or executed. SDK request/state handling has local boundary tests.
A matching public package release and explicit publication approval remain required.

The parent Catalogue reference includes the independent lineage feature. It was preserved unchanged; the Notebook-only runtime does not include that feature. Combined release verification remains required.
